items.title: Abby “Chinee Bébé” Foster Interview, 1961-03-21
items.q: To Black Happy, he'll tell you the same thing. He's scared to go up against Red Happy.

ctx.x: In other words, in other words, I took his own stuff. Well, I didn't say my own stuff, but the band said it. The first man that gave me the credit was Emil Bigard. Oh, yeah. That man, you're poor race, come along, he heard me. And he said I was a better drummer. Oh, yeah. So, then we come back, they kept bucking against each other out in the street, after we went with me. So, I left the punch band, went with the tuxedo band. So, the night that we was a player up at Salisthans Pavilion, they had a dance at the…

items.title: Abby “Chinee Bébé” Foster Interview, 1961-03-09
items.q: Him and I used to fight all the time... He would play with Chris Kelly's band and I would play with Celestine. So it come down to a showdown.

ctx.x: Can you tell us anything about Red Happy's drumming? Anything about him? because I never got to hear him.
